title: Larry Flynt asks Christic Institute to investigate Jessica Savitch's death, with G. Gordon Liddy

tellings.quote: look uh I want to retain you at this chis The christic Institute that you guys have uh we'd like to retain you to uh investigate uh the death of uh of uh Savage

plain: In the 1980s, at the Park Hotel in Washington, the publisher Larry Flynt is said to have asked the Christic Institute, a legal and investigative group Dan Sheehan worked with, to look into the death of the television news anchor Jessica Savitch, with the Watergate figure G. Gordon Liddy also part of the meeting. Sheehan tells Michels he was there, and that Flynt said: "we'd like to retain you to investigate the death of" Savitch. If true, Flynt suspected her death was more than it seemed.
